mapper.select: SELECT c.conversation_id AS conversationId,c.title,c.status, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt, (SELECT e.status FROM t_m_announce_ai_execution e WHERE e.conversation_id=c.conversation_id AND e.user_id=c.user_id AND e.parent_execution_id IS NULL AND e.delete_flag=1 ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS executionStatus FROM t_m_announce_ai_conversation c WHERE c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.delete_flag=1 AND c.status='active' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.conversation_id AS conversationId,c.title,c.status, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt, (SELECT e.status FROM t_m_announce_ai_execution e WHERE e.conversation_id=c.conversation_id AND e.user_id=c.user_id AND e.parent_execution_id IS NULL AND e.delete_flag=1 ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS executionStatus FROM t_m_announce_ai_conversation c WHERE c.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.delete_flag=1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_m_announce_ai_conversation SET title=#{title},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1
UPDATE t_m_announce_ai_message SET delete_flag=0,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1
UPDATE t_m_announce_ai_conversation SET delete_flag=0,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1
UPDATE t_m_announce_ai_conversation SET updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1
mapper.select: SELECT m.message_id AS messageId,m.role,m.payload FROM t_m_announce_ai_message m JOIN t_m_announce_ai_execution e ON e.id=m.agent_execution_id WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.user_id=#{userId} AND m.delete_flag=1 AND e.delete_flag=1 AND e.parent_execution_id IS NULL ORDER BY m.sequence_no

SELECT m.message_id AS messageId,m.role,m.payload,e.run_id AS runId, e.parent_execution_id AS parentExecutionId FROM t_m_announce_ai_message m JOIN t_m_announce_ai_execution e ON e.id=m.agent_execution_id WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.user_id=#{userId} AND m.delete_flag=1 AND e.delete_flag=1 ORDER BY m.sequence_no
